title: Prisma with Route Handlers
description: Build REST APIs using Prisma in Next.js Route Handlers for GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE endpoints.

data.text: Route Handlers in Next.js App Router replace the Pages Router API routes. They run on the server and can directly access Prisma Client, making them ideal for building REST or GraphQL APIs.

data.content: Fetch all posts in a Route Handler.

data.content: Create a post in a Route Handler.

data.title: Note
data.text: Route Handlers support all HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE). Use them to build a complete REST API alongside your Next.js pages.
